source.title: Jamey Eisenberg's mid-August risers and fallers
source.author: Jamey Eisenberg
source.summary: Updates rankings for preseason injuries, depth-chart movement, and changing roles.

takeaways.label: target
takeaways.summary: Murray's confirmed Minnesota starting job, Kevin O'Connell, strong weapons, and rushing history create top-12 upside.
takeaways.rationale: Murray's confirmed Minnesota starting job, Kevin O'Connell, strong weapons, and rushing history create top-12 upside.

takeaways.label: target
takeaways.summary: Mason may be taking Minnesota's lead job and has produced efficiently when given double-digit carries.
takeaways.rationale: Mason may be taking Minnesota's lead job and has produced efficiently when given double-digit carries.
risks: Limited receiving work lowers his floor.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Cleveland is designing touches for Concepcion, making him a possible weekly three-receiver-league starter despite poor quarterback play.
takeaways.rationale: Cleveland is designing touches for Concepcion, making him a possible weekly three-receiver-league starter despite poor quarterback play.
risks: Cleveland's quarterback situation may cap consistency.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Strong camp and preseason usage inside and outside give Stribling a path into San Francisco's depleted receiver rotation.
takeaways.rationale: Strong camp and preseason usage inside and outside give Stribling a path into San Francisco's depleted receiver rotation.
risks: Veterans ahead of him missed the evaluated game.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Lloyd is tracking as Green Bay's RB2 and could become an RB2 if Josh Jacobs misses time.
takeaways.rationale: Lloyd is tracking as Green Bay's RB2 and could become an RB2 if Josh Jacobs misses time.
risks: Lloyd has played only one NFL game because of injuries.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Coleman is Denver's RB3 but has contingent upside behind injury-prone veterans and could earn designed work.
takeaways.rationale: Coleman is Denver's RB3 but has contingent upside behind injury-prone veterans and could earn designed work.
risks: He may open the season third on the depth chart.

takeaways.label: avoid
takeaways.summary: A vague camp injury, age 30, and 450 touches make McCaffrey too risky near pick six.
takeaways.rationale: A vague camp injury, age 30, and 450 touches make McCaffrey too risky near pick six.
risks: San Francisco has downplayed the current tightness.

takeaways.label: avoid
takeaways.summary: A high-ankle sprain, difficult schedule, and committee risk move Love from Round 2 into Round 3.
takeaways.rationale: A high-ankle sprain, difficult schedule, and committee risk move Love from Round 2 into Round 3.
risks: The recommendation could improve if he returns fully before Week 1.

takeaways.label: avoid
takeaways.summary: Stefon Diggs' arrival creates meaningful target competition and makes McLaurin risky at WR21 cost.
takeaways.rationale: Stefon Diggs' arrival creates meaningful target competition and makes McLaurin risky at WR21 cost.
risks: McLaurin retains the higher individual ceiling.
